notes.title: Leavers Rift - Content Update I
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/dafda6308f8f8ed7656d8bf3bd1dfab94e0c1877.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Patchnotes 0.2.0[/h1][h2]Content Update I[/h2][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]This is the first major update for the Early Access of Leavers Rift![/p][p]I decided to combine the planned content updates I and III into one big update, as both contain new enemies, relics, and events. This made debugging them much easier and more efficient. Especially since several combats were reworked or completely redesigned, as the new enemies are now part of them.[/p][list][*][p][b]10 new enemies[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]30+ new relics[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]18 new events (6 per region)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More than half of the new relics are part of the events. Some cursed relics will also find their way into your collection, whether you like it or not, depending on your decisions during certain events.[/p][p]Half of the new enemies have settled in Region 2, the Suffering Desert, where the variety of enemies was still somewhat limited, especially since most of the previous Region 2 enemies also have alternative forms in other regions. Get ready to fight the smaller representatives of the monolith![/p][p][/p][h2]Furthermore[/h2][h3]Buffs:[/h3][p]Legionnaire:[/p][list][*][p][b]Leaking Neadle[/b] costs 2 mana (instead of 3)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]The targeting arrow ignores the heroes now, if they shouldn't be allowed to be targeted. Example: You can't target yourself with your attacks anymore. [i](Sometimes it's the most obvious things that you overlook.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cursed Slime[/b] has the "Impairment" tag now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magma[/b] has the "Impairment" tag now.[/p][p][i](Both were just undefined cards, so relics or echos couldn't interact with them.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Loading screen shows the correct encyclopedia entry of the formless. [i](It's not a snail actually.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Other:[/h3][list][*][p]The Monolith boss fight has an altered version depending on the outcome of one of the new events.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some rewards of harder non-elite battles. More rares and epics![/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some hit boxes of bigger enemies, so it's easier to target enemies behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor changes to environment design of region 3 boards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]--[/p][p]Finally, I would like to clarify once again: Early Access may still be a long way from a financial breakthrough. But development is of course progressing; as this update is intended to prove.[/p][p][/p][p]The fourth hero, the Soul Marionette, should be released in November! It is already programmed and in the final testing and artwork phase.[/p][p][/p][p]The remaining chapters with the second half of the story and 9 new game boards will be released in January according to plan.[/p][p][/p][p]The goal is to release 1.0 in February/March.[/p]

notes.title: Leavers Rift - Early Access live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/65557f98b79c295bd183adc97c04571b0980efe0.png"][/img][/p][h1]Early Access for Leavers Rift is now live![/h1][p][/p][h3]Here's what you can expect: [/h3][list][*][p]3 heroes, Legionnaire, Jinni, and Sun Mantis, each with 60 unique cards. [/p][/*][*][p]30+ hours of content. [/p][/*][*][p]About half of the story spread across 3 chapters. [/p][/*][*][p]9 hand-crafted maps to explore, 3 per chapter. [/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of enemies with their own unique mechanics and cards. [/p][/*][*][p]~ 100 relics. [/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of events. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In addition, it is optimized and debugged.[/p][p][/p][p][i]"A lost child has been soothed, but the eternal sleep will return.[/i][/p][p][i]You look up into the sky, where space and time are continuously devouring each other.[/i][/p][p][i]Your day will come. But for now, it means facing the adventure anew..."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]All feedback is welcome. Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Early Access - 0.1.2
notes.notes: [h1]Patch Notes - 0.1.2[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/1674e98b1e33f38f2abdd2befefbcce7f252718f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Balancing: [/h2][h3]Nerfs: [/h3][p]Enemies:[/p][list][*][p][b]Formless standard attacks[/b] weakened.[/p][/*][*][p]Wingtail Calf's [b]“Crying for Help”[/b] is now triggered at 10% HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monolith's reactive modules[/b] adjusted. No random sandworms or discards anymore.[/p][/*][/list][p]Cards:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shadow Crawler's Fingers[/b] costs 1 Mana now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Buffs:[/h3][p]Enemies:[/p][list][*][p]All enemies in regions 2 and 3 have more health. Previously, enemies were scaled linearly without taking the additional mana into account.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other: [/h2][list][*][p][b]Shadow Crawler[/b] has an additional text box: (unequipped relics)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monolith's reactive modules[/b] feature additional tooltips for every possible outcome.[/p][/*][*][p]The placement of some enemy actions has been adjusted to make it easier to display tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]The bonus effects of the chapters have swapped places.[/p][list][*][p]Chapter 2: Healing after bosses halved. (Previously: All enemies have 25% more health)[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 3: All enemies have 25% more health. (Previously: The combat step counter is triggered 5 fields earlier.)[/p][/*][*][p]> This change is a result of the general increase in health points from Region 2 onwards, which means that a further increase only occurs in Chapter 3, when the player has the opportunity to reliably upgrade all their cards to level 2.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugs fixed: [/h2][list][*][p]Chapter 1; region 3: Fixed a missing node connection to the blacksmith[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Pre Early Access Release - 0.1.1
notes.notes: [h1]Patch Notes - 0.1.1[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/0e831684b96c46e5acd01d9c02cb46432ac8c162.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Features: [/h2][list][*][p][b]Instructions[/b] added to the main menu. [/p][/*][*][p]If an enemy has a [b]modified caution counter[/b], damage cards now show the [b]calculated values[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balancing: [/h2][h3]Nerfs: [/h3][list][*][p][b]Convincing Strike.[/b] [b][i]ATK+[/i][/b] has been removed. The Legionnaire is designed to scale ATK+/DEF+ primarily through weapon morphs.[/p][/*][*][p]Sporedragon Mother's [b][i]"End is near..."[/i][/b] only increases every second skill of the player. Still increases for EVERY skill of the Mother. This allows rust only decks to defeat the first boss now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugs fixed: [/h2][list][*][p]The first story scenes of all NPCs were designed specifically for region 1, which led to the ‘bug’ that get-to-know stories in region 2 and 3 showed images from region 1. Now there are new images for the unlikely but possible case that you meet the characters in region 2 or 3 for the first time.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Leavers Rift - Demo now live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/2433aefbd04665eda695a13c19c2d328155ef145.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][h1][b]The Leavers Rift Demo is now live![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]After years of development, the first public build of [i]Leavers Rift[/i] is now available as a free demo on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is included?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]First hero: The Legionnaire - with all his relics and cards[/p][/*][*][p]ALL current relics, events, neutral cards[/p][/*][*][p]The entire first chapter[/p][/*][*][p]All 3 regions with all enemies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What is not included?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Heroes: Jinni and Sun Mantis[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 2 and 3[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements / Unlockables[/p][/*][*][p]Everything that's planned to be added to the main game during Early Access, like:[/p][list][*][p]Hero Soul Marionette[/p][/*][*][p]Chapters 4-10[/p][/*][*][p]new enemies and bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Region 4[/p][/*][*][p]new relics, events, neutral cards[/p][/*][*][p]more Achievements[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]How many hours does the demo offer?[/b][/h3][p]Well, it’s still a roguelike, so… infinite?[/p][p]Jokes aside: A full run with the Legionnaire through chapter 1 takes about 3 hours - assuming you make it on your first try.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The demo will be permanently available for the time being.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the demo, please add Leavers Rift to your Wishlist and tell everyone about it![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and welcome to Leavers Rift![/p][p]Matthias / Wolfhain[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Who is Wolfhain?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676411/e51c8b88be8a558bf88ce6c064c08724ddc41fe4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Who is Wolfhain?[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Hi everyone! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]I'm Matthias - solo developer of [i]Leavers Rift[/i].[/p][p]But maybe you're wondering: [b]Who's behind all this?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]From Fantasy Novels to Game Dev[/h3][p]Before I began crafting [i]Leavers Rift[/i], I spent years as a fantasy and drama hobby writer. Worldbuilding, surreal stories, and emotional arcs have always fascinated me. Game development started as a side project - a way to bring my own worlds to life in a more interactive form. What began with small experiments grew into something much larger...[/p][p]In the blink of an eye, two years had passed.[/p][p][/p][h3]Leavers Rift: My Debut Project[/h3][p]This is my first game. Art, design, code, writing - nearly every piece comes from me. Of course there are some assets, like some generic rocks. But about 95% is selfmade without any budget or connections.[/p][p][/p][h3]Why Early Access?[/h3][p]The first Act of [i]Leavers Rift[/i] is already fully playable, but it’s built to grow. I want to balance new content around real feedback and improve with the community. Early Access lets me do just that - transparently and step by step.[/p][p]Sure, some budget for OSTs, more languages or to make a living of it might be helpful. But if there's one thing I’ve learned, it’s how to complete a project even without a budget. Years of writing as a hobbyist taught me that passion and persistence can carry you further than you’d think.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thanks for Reading[/h3][p]I've forgotten half of what I wanted to say anyway, but the main thing is that you now know a bit better who I am! In today's developer landscape, transparency is more important than ever, with all the AIs, bots, trolls and that part of our industry that we indies distance ourselves from.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're curious or interested, feel free to play the Demo![/p][p]And if not already done: every wishlist helps![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being here.[/p][p][/p][p]Matthias / Wolfhain[/p]
